evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of leg swelling and breathlessness concerning for heart
failure.

Findings: Normal sinus rhythm at 84 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 163 ms, QRS 82 ms, QTc
418 ms.
Impression: Normal sinus rhythm with voltage criteria for left ventricular hypertrophy.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
60%. Trace mitral regurgitation. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.

Fasting lipid panel this admission: total cholesterol: 270 mg/dL, LDL: 181 mg/dL, HDL: 46
mg/dL, triglycerides: 216 mg/dL.

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 144 mmol/L
Potassium: 5.0 mmol/L
Chloride: 106 mmol/L
CO2: 22 mmol/L
BUN: 20 mg/dL
Creatinine: 0.7 mg/dL
Glucose: 158 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 10.1 mg/dL

Metoprolol succinate 50 mg by mouth once daily
Losartan 50 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Warfarin 5 mg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: alert, no acute distress.
Neck: no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, soft systolic murmur at the
sternal border, no gallop.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: no peripheral edema.
